crossRefs.note: They brought in Yahweh’s ark, and set it in its place, in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and…
Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before Yahweh.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Then the king and all Israel with him offered sacrifices before the LORD.
translations.kjv: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.
translations.asv: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before Jehovah.
